turnout.notes: Kentucky turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until the collected Kentucky State Board turnout and registration PDF leads are parsed, reconciled, and caveated against county-clerk official documentation.

certifiedResults.manualTranscriptionCaveat: Elliott County official PDF is image-only; the derived text artifact includes a manual transcription of President and U.S. House rows from rendered official PDF pages.

reviewCharts.warning: Kentucky review rows are precinct-level President-versus-U.S. House comparisons extracted from official county recap PDFs. U.S. House is district-based and some counties have uncontested or county-only rows; Elliott County is image-only and uses a manual transcription of the President and U.S. House rows from the official PDF scan.

historicalBaselines.warning: Kentucky historical baseline rows are official county-level presidential results from 2012, 2016, and 2020 Kentucky election-results PDFs. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data.
